fns.desc: macsec_drv_init_sockets() opens drv->common.sock and eloop_register_read_sock()s it, then leaks both fd and eloop registration on all 5 later failure returns (SIOCGIFINDEX ioctl, bind(), multicast membership, SIOCGIFHWADDR ioctl, bad hwaddr family); caller just os_free(drv)s. 3rd instance of this exact shape after driver_roboswitch.c and driver_macsec_qca.c.

macsec_drv_macsec_deinit() frees drv->sk/link_cache/ctx.sk but never drv->link; if reached while a transmit SC is still active (delete_transmit_sc not called first), drv->link leaks. Lower confidence: depends on caller teardown discipline not verified in this file.
